snippet.title: Valor Mortis - Story Trailer | Launching October 13
snippet.description:
On October 13, charge into a supernatural retelling of the Napoleonic Wars in Valor Mortis. A first-person soulslike by the creators of Ghostrunner, wield swords, firearms and magic spells to gain the survive a brutal, challenging and innovative combat system. 

As Napoleon's conquest halts in Eastern Europe, a plague spreads across the continent in its wake. This same dark affliction courses through William Dowsett's veins, corrupting his body yet granting him a dangerous power: he now hears the voice of Emperor Bonaparte in his mind, guiding him to usurp The Shrike's resistance of the commonfolk.


Wishlist Now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828710/Valor_Mortis/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016571
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/valor-mortis/9p861v1542bl

Coming to Steam, PS5, and Xbox, and day one with Xbox Game Pass.
